name: Fremont Police Explorers (Post 119)
what_you_do: Learn about police work as a volunteer Explorer. You help at community events and with traffic control. You also go on ride-alongs, building tours and school visits. You go to a meeting every week.
who_can_apply: Teens 14 to 18 when they join. You must be in high school or have finished it. You need a C+ (2.5) grade average and must turn in report cards each term. No school discipline in the last year for things like theft, bullying or violence.
pay_detail: This is a volunteer program. The program page does not mention pay.
duration: Weekly meetings and training. New Explorers do a 4 to 6 month field training and a one week academy in San Diego their first summer.
deadline_text: The program page says applications are closed right now. It gives no date for the next round.
how_to_apply: When it opens, send four things: a one page essay on why you want to join, your latest report card, the Teen Volunteer Application and the Explorer application. Then you have an interview and a background check. Questions: (510) 790-6691.
notes: The background check takes about 1 to 2 months. You must go to the first three meetings. If you are not accepted, you can apply again after one year.
